clips.caption:
A $35 difference in postage may have cost a man millions.

Kevin Trudeau had two separate strangers, on the exact same Saturday, independently tell him he should sell his memory course on TV. Both sent contracts: his friend Ed Beckley by Federal Express, for $35. Bobby Singer by regular mail.

Ed's contract landed first. Kevin signed with him - then had to call Bobby Singer to say he'd already been beaten to it. Bobby's words: "That $35 may have cost me millions."

Kevin went with Ed Beckley instead. They sold $450 million worth of courses on television.

How much is speed costing you right now?
